name: E2E Teamwork - workflow stages
description: Workflow + stage created through MakeApiCall and attached to a fresh project → ListWorkflows → ListWorkflowStages → ChangeTaskWorkflowStage; deletes project and workflow.

ee9905a7-a9a6-48e2-898e-3b109470a0e5.content:
## ℹ️ Self-contained, but needs a paid plan or trial

The flow creates its own workflow (v3 POST workflows.json — the body MUST carry `workflowOptions: {}` or Teamwork answers 500), adds a stage, attaches the workflow to the fresh project and moves the task into the stage; everything is deleted at the end. Workflows are not available on the Free plan (appmixer2.eu); verified on the trial site appmixer3.eu on 2026-10-14.
